mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article ( title, summary, content, category, cover, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{category}, #{cover}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, cover = #{cover}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT id, title, summary, content, category, cover, create_time, update_time
FROM article
ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT
id, title, summary, content, category, cover, create_time, update_time
FROM article
WHERE id=#{id}
